description: A Java class implementing a log filtering node for processing log messages, specifically designed to pass along only the message content while filtering out other metadata. Part of a logging utility framework.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that implements the LogNode interface, passing only message strings to the next node in the logging chain, ignoring other metadata like priority, tag, and throwable.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor accepting a LogNode to facilitate chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Default constructor for the log filter with no initial next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message by forwarding only the message part to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
